raised: The page never says which product the reader's own savings are in
"123 מקור · 123 מחושב" is confusing; unclear what clicking a number shows
Counts don't match: "כל המוצרים 105" vs "96 מסלולים ב־7 מוצרים" vs 9 buttons
Main table is very long, about 9 screens of near-identical rows
Rows sorted by fee within each product, so the S&P 500 track moves around and has to be hunted for
Grey product bars scroll away, so the reader loses track of which product they are in
"תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים" is unclear; doesn't know what it is or whether it's theirs
PF-06 / PF-10 note codes mean nothing
Unclear whether the cheap S&P 500 options under "קרנות מחקות"/"קרנות סל" are the same kind of thing or available to them
Donut charts and teal/yellow dots are not understood (what a full yellow ring means)
Many rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" and give nothing to compare
Doesn't understand "מהחיסכון" vs "מההפקדות" in real money or which is cheaper
Unclear whether "אין" and "0%" mean the same thing
Doesn't understand "מט"ח" or how a track can be 99% shares and 99% foreign currency
Unclear whether returns "לפני דמי ניהול" mean they must subtract the fee themselves
Doesn't understand "קבועים / משתנים / נאמן", "4A / 4D", "צוברת"
Doesn't understand "עוד לא דווח", "הלכה יהודית", "גמיש", "קיימות"
Unclear what makes "מרכזית לפיצויים" different from the others
Missing: what the fees mean in shekels for them
Missing: how to switch tracks and whether it costs money or triggers tax
Missing: a simple side-by-side view of just the S&P 500 track across products
Missing: performance in bad years / worst drop, since only averages are shown
Would drop the "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" documents list
Would drop "חיסכון לכל ילד" and "מרכזית לפיצויים"
Would drop the "קופה" number column
Would drop the "לא מצאתם שם?" search box

problems.why: The reader mentions column headings only for the sort arrows they ignored, and never says anything about a '?' help mark dropping onto its own line or looking out of place.
